name: Steam Rise
description: A slow push-in on something warm, with steam curling through a side light and dust in the beam. The cheapest of the motion seeds.
prompt: Gentle steam rises from {{product}}, soft morning side light, slow push-in, dust motes in the beam, cosy ambience
